### With God on the Mountain
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/god-mountain
Passage: Exodus 24:1-11
Points:
- In the Old Testament, sharing a peace-offering meal served as a tangible picture of peace and intimacy with God.
- Israel's leaders experienced the remarkable privilege of beholding God on Mount Sinai without facing judgment.
- This fellowship meal was made possible only after sacrificial blood was sprinkled to seal the covenant.
- For new covenant believers, the Lord's Supper functions as a fellowship meal celebrating reconciliation through Christ's blood.
- Communing at the Table renews our commitment and reminds us of the eternal peace won on the cross.
